newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli industrial output rose in first quarter.
newsitem.headline: Israeli industrial output rose in first quarter.

text.p: Israel's industrial production grew by a seasonally adjusted monthly average of 0.1 percent in the first quarter, according to preliminary figures from the Central Bureau of Statistics released on Sunday.
The figures reversed a fourth-quarter 1996 decline averaging 0.2 percent a month, the bureau said.
It said industrial output rose by a monthly average of 0.5 percent in the first quarter of 1996, 0.4 percent in the second quarter and 0.1 percent in the third.
The bureau said the average number of hours worked by industrial employees fell by 0.2 percent a month in the first quarter of 1997, about the same pace as in the previous quarter.
Average hours worked increased by 0.1 to 0.2 percent in the first two quarters of 1996 and remained stable in the third quarter before falling in the fourth.
